metrics.label: Rolling three-season regular: team NetRtg RMSE

models.name: One-season ridge RAPM
models.change: Trunk: signed player identities with ridge regularization.

models.name: One-season Bayesian RAPM
models.change: + posterior uncertainty; same ridge posterior mean.

models.name: One-season additive neural RAPM
models.change: + learned scalar player embeddings.

models.name: One-season Deep Sets
models.change: + nonlinear permutation-invariant lineup aggregation.

models.name: One-season categorical CatBoost
models.change: + boosted categorical player and lineup interactions.

models.name: One-season RAPM + Transformer
models.change: + attention residual on a frozen ridge prediction.

models.name: Frozen lagged RAPM
models.change: + completed prior-season player RAPM as a preseason prior.

models.name: Forward 1-year RAPM-prior baseline
models.change: + recursive prior centered on the immediately preceding completed annual RAPM state.

models.name: Forward 3-year RAPM-prior baseline
models.change: + player-specific possession-weighted memory of the preceding three annual RAPM states.

models.name: Complete player-prior RAPM
models.change: + value-conditioned aging, draft/physical inputs, exposure-gated rookie cold starts, replacement tokens, and possession-weighted prior centering; context and box-score priors remain off.

models.name: Additive Profile-Prior RAPM
models.change: + moves HPM x3's additive player profiles into a strictly lagged residual prior; lineup context remains off.

models.name: Additive Prior Plus Linear Shape Context
models.change: + six non-additive HPM x3 lineup-shape features in standardized linear Ridge context; no spline or quadratic basis.

models.name: Frozen 1-year no-prior RAPM
models.change: Freeze a zero-centered 2024-25 RAPM fit before 2025-26.

models.name: Frozen pooled 3-year no-prior RAPM
models.change: + pool 2022-23 through 2024-25 into one player coefficient.

models.name: Frozen aging prior
models.change: + age, experience, draft, and physical-profile prior.

models.name: Frozen offense/defense RAPM
models.change: + separate offense and defense player ratings.

models.name: Frozen draft cold-start prior
models.change: + draft profile for first-NBA-season players.

models.name: Frozen exposure-gated cold-start prior
models.change: + first-year exposure gate and replacement-token blend.

models.name: Frozen exposure-gated O/D cold-start prior
models.change: + O/D cold starts with separate replacement tokens.

models.name: Recursive exposure-gated RAPM
models.change: + leakage-safe recursive cold-start state by season.

models.name: Student-t recursive RAPM
models.change: Gaussian stint errors replaced by Student-t errors.

models.name: Student-t talent-prior RAPM
models.change: + heavy-tailed player departures from the prior.

models.name: Forward contextual RAPM
models.change: + lagged nonlinear lineup-composition offset on the recursive exposure-gated state.

models.name: Forward decomposed contextual RAPM
models.change: Ablation: replace relative context with identifiable home-side minus away-side context.

models.name: Forward portable-matchup contextual RAPM
models.change: + exact antisymmetry and an identified portable-unit plus matchup decomposition.

models.name: Student-t talent-prior contextual RAPM
models.change: + heavy-tailed player-prior departures while retaining the lagged contextual offset.

models.name: Forward hierarchical P-spline contextual RAPM
models.change: + P-spline curvature regularization and a projected prior-season context-function hierarchy.

models.name: Forward bounded hierarchical P-spline contextual RAPM
models.change: + 5th-95th percentile feature bounds, P-spline curvature regularization, and a projected prior-season function hierarchy.

models.name: Forward bounded hierarchical portable-matchup contextual RAPM
models.change: + model-level 5th-95th percentile side and symmetric matchup bounds.

models.name: Forward aging bounded hierarchical portable-matchup contextual RAPM
models.change: + recursively selected aging transition for returning-player priors; retain exposure-gated rookie cold starts.

models.name: Forward centered aging bounded hierarchical portable-matchup contextual RAPM
models.change: + possession-weighted centering of every season's complete player-prior vector.

models.name: Value-Conditioned Aging HPM
models.change: + ridge-penalized age-by-prior-RAPM interaction in the forward aging branch.

models.name: HIPSTER PM v2: Depth-Aware Shooting
models.change: Ablation: replace raw lineup three-point makes and attempts with shooting depth, capped capacity, and concentration features.

models.name: HIPSTER PM v2.1: Empirical Rebound Capacity
models.change: + replace raw and square-root rebound volume with expected unit ORB% and DRB% learned from completed-season rebound opportunities against a reference opponent field.

models.name: HIPSTER PM v2.2: Usage Allocation
models.change: Ablation: replace raw usage, turnovers, concentration, and depth-by-usage with empirical terminal-action demand, allocation entropy, role reallocation, and allocation-weighted turnover burden.

models.name: HIPSTER PM v2.3: Shot Portfolio
models.change: + forward rim-pressure, spacing-capacity, and rim-by-spacing interaction signals with bounded hierarchical P-spline responses.

models.name: HPM x1: ORB Claim Context
models.change: Experiment: add one summed prior-player ORB% claim-total contextual feature to the controlled no-context value-conditioned baseline.

models.name: HPM x2: Raw OREB/100 Context
models.change: Experiment: replace summed ORB% claims with one summed prior-player OREB/100 context feature.

models.name: HPM x3: ORB Claim Rebound Replacement
models.change: Replace HPM v1's five rebounding features with one summed prior-player ORB% claim-total feature; retain all other HPM v1 context signals.

models.name: Linear-Ridge HPM x3 Context
models.change: Keep x3's feature contract and player-prior pipeline, replacing bounded hierarchical P-splines with standardized linear Ridge context.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM v1.0
models.change: - retire imputed-profile count and replacement-profile weight. The remaining 14 coordinates are basketball features; this is the canonical NAIL-RAPM v1.0 contract.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM Additive-Only Context
models.change: - all six non-additive lineup coordinates; retain only the eight player-additive basketball profile totals in the same lineup-level Ridge fit.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM Uniform-300 Source-Season Anchor
models.change: Controlled padding ablation: retain uniform 300-possession formulas but replace the expanding historical league anchor with the immediately prior season's league rate.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM v1.1 Stat-Specific Padding
models.change: + statistic-specific profile stabilization constants; decompose 3PM into volume and accuracy and usage into FGA, FTA, and turnovers.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM v1.2 Gap-Returner Priors
models.change: + advance established players through each unobserved season with the existing aging transition and retain their last observed padded profile on return.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM v1.2.1 Pruned Non-Additive Context
models.change: - four directionally unresolved non-additive terms; retain only usage concentration and top-two assists. Cleared the direct full-game bootstrap gate versus v1.2.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM v1.2.1.1 Standard USG% (Not Promoted)
models.change: ~ replace internal action-events-per-on-court-possession usage with conventional box-score USG% in both additive profile and usage concentration. Cleared the direct no-material-harm bootstrap gate, but did not materially change interpretation and is not promoted.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM v1.2.1.2 Back-to-Back Control (Prior Production)
models.change: + one known-before-tipoff schedule covariate: home back-to-back minus away back-to-back, fit as a forward weighted-Ridge control separate from player and lineup features. Superseded by v1.2.1.3, which preserves this control while selecting player lambda directly on each source residualized target.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM v1.2.1.3 Residualized-Target Lambda CV (Production)
models.change: ~ keep the complete v1.2.1.2 contract fixed, but select each season's player Ridge penalty with three-fold CV on the context- and B2B-residualized target. No fitted lambda schedule or state is imported from another model artifact. Promoted after winning the agreed frozen comparison and ranking/coefficient review.

models.name: Split NAIL-RAPM Constrained O/D Decomposition (Not Promoted)
models.change: ~ refit player, additive-profile, non-additive lineup, home-court, and back-to-back terms in paired total/specialization coordinates. The constrained O/D split improves eligible game-margin RMSE, but is weaker on possession error, full-game margins, and winner accuracy, so it is not promoted.

models.name: NAIL Critical Spacing Candidate
models.change: + binary non-additive indicator for two or more lower-tercile shrunk 3PM/100 players. The coefficient has 79.9% negative directional mass, but there is no meaningful pooled full-game lift yet.

models.name: NAIL Quartile Critical Spacing Plus Standard USG% (Not Promoted)
models.change: + lower-quartile two-low-threat Critical Spacing indicator; ~ replace internal usage-events rate with conventional USG%. Near-tied possession error but worse primary pooled game metrics.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM v1.2.2 Defensive-Rebound Profile (Not Promoted)
models.change: + defensive rebound percentage as a ninth additive profile coordinate. Cleared the no-material-harm bootstrap gate, but failed the 80% positive-sign stability gate (21 of 29 seasons).

models.name: NAIL-RAPM v1.2.3 Free-Throw Profile (Not Promoted)
models.change: + free-throw attempts per 100 as a ninth additive profile coordinate. Directionally stable, but not competitive on the primary frozen margin metrics.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM v1.2.4 Free-Throw Replacement (Not Promoted)
models.change: - additive usage per 100; + free-throw attempts per 100. Resolves additive collinearity, but does not improve frozen margin metrics.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM v1.3 Expanded Additive Profiles
models.change: + defensive rebound percentage, free-throw rate, unassisted rim makes, and unassisted three makes in the additive player profile. Not promoted after failing the full-game bootstrap gate.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM v1.3.1 Pruned Additive Profile
models.change: - three-point attempts/100 and usage/100 after the partial-effect stability audit; retains the remaining additive profiles and non-additive lineup terms. Preferred within the v1.3 branch after passing the direct bootstrap gate.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM v1.4 Kalman Additive Profiles
models.change: Replace the discarded fixed pseudo-observation state with a proper forward Kalman posterior mean and covariance for the 12 additive profile coefficients; retain independent zero-centered coefficients for the six non-additive lineup terms. Not promoted after a 2024-25 full-game bootstrap-gate failure.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM Normalized Context Penalty
models.change: Replace fixed raw context alpha=10,000 with a leakage-safe normalized lambda_C=0.704 selected over 23 pre-frozen seasons. Rejected after worse frozen regular-season prediction.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM Fixed Context Alpha 1,000
models.change: Sensitivity ablation: reduce the raw context Ridge penalty from 10,000 to 1,000 while holding the full v1.1 contract fixed. Rejected after frozen evaluation.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM Fixed Context Alpha 5,000
models.change: Sensitivity ablation and exact pre-frozen minimum: reduce the raw context Ridge penalty from 10,000 to 5,000. Rejected after frozen evaluation.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM Fixed Context Alpha 20,000
models.change: Sensitivity ablation and paired one-standard-error selection: increase the raw context Ridge penalty from 10,000 to 20,000. Rejected after it did not beat the incumbent on frozen evaluation.

models.name: NAIL-RAPM Cross-Season Profile Padding
models.change: Alternative: fit each padding constant on player transitions ending by 2022-23. Rejected because the primitive-profile winner did not win downstream frozen prediction.

models.name: NAIL Token MLP Residual
models.change: + shared nonlinear MLP over eight strictly lagged player-profile tokens; predict the frozen additive-only NAIL residual without communication between player tokens.

models.name: NAIL Within-Unit Set Attention Residual
models.change: Replace the independent token transform with two layers of four-head within-unit self-attention; retain the same eight fields, residual target, and frozen evaluation contract.

models.name: Linear HPM x3: Quadratic Side Context
models.change: + one Ridge-penalized squared side-total term for each player-compilable additive feature; no spline basis.

models.name: Forward Compiled-Additive-Prior HPM x3
models.change: + carry the eight learned additive profile coefficients into the following player prior; only six non-additive lineup-shape terms remain carried context. Rejected on regular-season forecasting.

models.name: HPM x4: ORB Claims + Blocks
models.change: Retain x3's summed ORB% claim feature, remove steals per 100, and retain blocks per 100 as the sole defensive-event signal.

models.name: HPM x5: Interaction-Only Creation
models.change: Remove direct assists and top-two-assists functions while retaining the shooter-by-passing interaction and x3's ORB% claim feature.

models.name: Controlled no-context value-conditioned RAPM
models.change: Ablation: retain the centered value-conditioned aging and cold-start prior, but set recursive lineup context to zero.

models.name: Forward context-reattributed HPM (rho=0.1)
models.change: Ablation: transfer rho=0.1 of player-projectable context into the next player prior and retain residual context.

models.name: Forward box-score residual HPM
models.change: + strictly lagged possession-native box-score residual for returning players; retain existing exposure-gated cold starts.

models.name: Forward box-score interaction HPM
models.change: + six strictly lagged, ridge-penalized box-score player-profile interactions for returning players.

models.name: Era-Conditioned Aging HPM
models.change: + ridge-penalized era-by-age-spline interaction in the centered value-conditioned aging branch.
